reason: The text describes an encounter at a well where shepherds drive away the seven daughters of the Midianite priest (Reuel). Moses intervenes to help the daughters and waters their flock. When the daughters return to their father, they report Moses's assistance respectfully, and their father welcomes him. There is no antagonism depicted between regular people and their leader. The antagonism present is between the shepherds and the daughters, not between common people and their leader. The daughters show respect toward their father Reuel throughout the narrative.
